t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The gnomes will appear in pre-determined pairs and will lead to certain types of basket and forest configs. Size etc irrelavent

vb_textbox.text: Focus on trying to see brown, pink, yellow and purple gnomes. These lead to the dark forest. The others lead to the bright forest.The highest yield of mushrooms available will move from dark to bright forest and back again. Start by trying to nail seeing the brown, pink, yellow and purple gnomes to train yourself to reach the dark forest with ease then start tracking the mushroom numbers. As they start to fall start selecting the other colour gnomes (not brown, pink, yellow & purple) to reach the other forest and keep the high mushroom yield.Then start trying to predict when yields are rising and falling in the respective forests and whilst using brown, pink, yellow and purple (or the other colours) to move between forests
